objective: Rein diagnostische Untersuchung, ob die bereits fixierten Q011-GDELT-Mechanismusgruppen im eingefrorenen Q014-Datensatz inkrementelle, voneinander unterscheidbare Information über zukünftige Marktbewegungen enthalten. Die Studie entscheidet keine Handelsregel und gibt keine Performancefreigabe.

event_contract.market_price_source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily close, fetched once for the exact fixed window and frozen into the Q015 input artifact

competing_explanations.H1_intensity_breadth: Zukünftige Assoziation wird überwiegend durch gemeinsame Event-Intensität/Breite getragen; die vier Volume/Breadth-Features können stark redundant sein.
competing_explanations.H2_severity: Negative-Goldstein-Severity enthält inkrementelle Information über generische Event-Intensität/Breite hinaus.
competing_explanations.H3_tone: Mean Tone enthält inkrementelle Information über generische Event-Intensität/Breite hinaus und ist deshalb mechanistisch unterscheidbar.
competing_explanations.H4_shared: Ein großer Teil der beobachtbaren Erklärungsleistung ist geteilt bzw. nicht gruppenspezifisch; einzelne Gruppen liefern nur geringe einzigartige Beiträge.

diagnostic_method.sample: event-only observations with complete target return for the tested asset/horizon
diagnostic_method.transform: Midrank transform applied independently to every predictor and outcome within each asset/horizon cell before regression; this is a fixed Spearman-compatible rank encoding.
diagnostic_method.model: Ordinary least squares with intercept on the full fixed feature set of the selected mechanism-group subset.
diagnostic_method.group_decomposition: Exact three-group Shapley decomposition of R-squared across all 6 permutations of the fixed group set; no feature, asset, horizon, subset-order, or parameter selection.
reported_quantities: R-squared for every fixed subset model
Shapley R-squared contribution for each mechanism group
arithmetic conservation check: sum of group Shapley contributions equals full-model R-squared within numerical tolerance

falsification_logic.H1_intensity_breadth: Falsified descriptively if its pre-specified Shapley contribution is non-positive in at least 3 of the 6 fixed asset/horizon cells.
falsification_logic.H2_severity: Falsified descriptively if its pre-specified Shapley contribution is non-positive in at least 3 of the 6 fixed asset/horizon cells.
falsification_logic.H3_tone: Falsified descriptively if its pre-specified Shapley contribution is non-positive in at least 3 of the 6 fixed asset/horizon cells.
falsification_logic.H4_shared: Disfavored descriptively only if the residual/shared explanation is not compatible with the fixed subset R-squared table and at least one mechanism group shows a positive Shapley contribution in at least 5 of the 6 fixed cells. This is not a trading-performance gate.

interpretation_guardrails: No group is selected, ranked, or promoted because it has the largest contribution in a cell.
No feature is selected within the intensity/breadth group.
No asset or horizon is selected from observed results.
The diagnostic does not authorize a trading rule, performance trial, holdout evaluation, gate change, or production use.
Any later performance hypothesis requires a separate preregistration, a fresh symbol-disjoint validation universe, unchanged evidence gates, and a fixed rule declared before data evaluation.
All Q015 outputs remain IDEAS/DIAGNOSTIC evidence only; they are not performance evidence.
